# Vendored design skills

These files ship with `/paseo-design` so the skill can read them without a second install. They stay out of the agent skill catalog.

| Path | Upstream | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `frontend-design/` | https://github.com/anthropics/skills `skills/frontend-design` | Apache-2.0 (`frontend-design/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `ui-ux-pro-max/` | https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill | MIT (`ui-ux-pro-max/LICENSE`) |
| `web-design-guidelines/` | https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills `skills/web-design-guidelines` | MIT (upstream README; that repo ships no LICENSE file) |
| `hermes/design-md/` | https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent `skills/creative/design-md` | MIT (`hermes/LICENSE`) |
| `hermes/claude-design/` | https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent `skills/creative/claude-design` | MIT (`hermes/LICENSE`) |
| `hermes/popular-web-designs/` | https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent `skills/creative/popular-web-designs` | MIT (`hermes/LICENSE`) |
| `hermes/dogfood/` | https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent `skills/software-development/dogfood` | MIT (`hermes/LICENSE`) |
